intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both offer {{course}} programmes in {{cityA}}. This page compares recorded year fees, 2023 placement rows and NIRF ranks from our table, with official sites opened in {{year}}.

NIET Greater Noida vs Sharda University is a private B.Pharm comparison. The 2023 highest packages on our records look unusually high for undergraduate pharmacy, so confirm them from an official report.

sections.heading: NIET Greater Noida vs Sharda University for B.Pharm: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose NIET if you want a recorded NIRF 2025 Pharmacy rank of 37, after you confirm which of the two Total Fees year figures, ₹1.057 lakh or ₹1.35 lakh, is current, and after you confirm the 2023 highest of ₹58 lakh from an official report.

Choose Sharda University if that campus fits you, with several recorded Total Fees year figures from ₹1.79 lakh to ₹1.96 lakh, a NIRF 2025 Pharmacy rank of 57, and a 2023 row that should also be confirmed officially because the highest is ₹70 lakh.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what to watch
paragraphs: For NIET we hold two Total Fees year figures for B.Pharm, ₹1,05,700 and ₹1.35 lakh. We have not chosen one as official, and we have not added them together.

For Sharda University we hold four Total Fees year figures for B.Pharm: ₹1,79,220, ₹1,84,597, ₹1,90,134 and ₹1,95,839. These look like year-wise amounts, but we have not added them into a four-year official total.
Confirm the current notices on niet.co.in and sharda.ac.in before you budget.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: NIET has a 2023 B.Pharm row of ₹10 lakh average and ₹58 lakh highest. Sharda University has a 2023 B.Pharm row of ₹25 lakh average and ₹70 lakh highest.

Those highest figures, and Sharda University's recorded average, are unusually high for undergraduate pharmacy. Treat them as recorded historical rows and ask both placement cells for the official 2023 or later report.
Do not treat these packages as a typical outcome until an official report confirms them.

sections.heading: Admission, ranks and eligibility
paragraphs: No entrance exam is mapped on this page. Follow each university's official B.Pharm admissions process, including any state counselling rules.

On our records, NIET has NIRF Pharmacy ranks of 37 in 2025, 40 in 2024 and 42 in 2023. Sharda University has NIRF Pharmacy ranks of 57 in 2025 and 69 in 2024. Confirm the current list on nirfindia.org.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both are private institutes recorded in Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh, so a local student can visit them on the same trip.
Visit the pharmacy labs and read the official offer letter for the exact year fee, rather than adding our stored rows.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Pick NIET if the NIRF 2025 Pharmacy rank of 37 matters more, after you confirm the current official year fee and the 2023 placement report.
Pick Sharda University if that campus is the offer you have, after official fee confirmation, without adding the four year figures into a total we have not confirmed.
Do not decide from the ₹58 lakh or ₹70 lakh highest rows alone.
